name: Lumen 0.3.0
body:
Lumen 0.3.0: Lumen now tells you when there is a newer release, and pictures stay sharp.

## New in this release
- **Updates.** Lumen checks for a newer release once a day and offers it. On Linux the AppImage replaces itself; on Windows it runs the installer. Turn the check off in Settings › Updates.
- **Sharper pictures.** A picture you add keeps its full resolution when you zoom in.
- **Paste and drop.** Paste a picture with Ctrl+V, or drag one onto the page.

## Fixed
- A question whose text starts with a digit no longer joins its number.
- The Android build is signed and installs over the last one.

The tablet builds still have no handwriting reader, maths reader or transcription.
